node.statement: Read literally, lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws exports u_grp only through the phrase inverse u_delta of the polar map and then asserts the C^1 formulas, identities, and estimates. Its contract does not export any set S_grp, any map h_grp, any declaration that Pi_delta:calU x B_delta^{calH}(J) -> S_grp has formula (U,H) |-> U bold-dot H and is bijective, or either inverse identity. Therefore it does not establish a polar datum satisfying the antecedent of lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality.
